name: PD 295 was established by Ordinance No. 19942, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 27,
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 295 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-295.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 295 was established by Ordinance No. 19942, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 27, 1988. Ordinance No. 19942 amended Ordinance Nos. 10962 and 19455, Chapters 51 and 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19455; 19942; 25711)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-295.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 295 is established on property generally located at the north corner of Park Forest Road and Stutz Drive. The size of PD 295 is approximately 1.149 acres. (Ord. Nos. 19942; 25711)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-295.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. 25711)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-295.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development of the Property must comply with the site analysis/development plan/landscape plan (Exhibit 295A). (Ord. Nos. 19942; 25711)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-295.105. USES.

Only those uses permitted in a Limited Office-2 District are permitted on the Property, including but not limited to medical clinic and office uses. (Ord. Nos. 19942; 25711)

sections.title: Landscape Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-295.106. LANDSCAPE PLAN.

Landscaping of the Property must comply with the site analysis/development plan/landscape plan. All landscaping must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 19942; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Floor Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-295.107. MAXIMUM FLOOR AREA.

Maximum floor area on the Property is 75,075 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 19942; 25711)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-295.108. SETBACKS.

The setbacks on the Property must comply with those provided by the existing building, as shown on the site analysis/development plan/landscape plan. (Ord. Nos. 19942; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-295.109. MAXIMUM COVERAGE.

Maximum coverage of the Property is 80 percent. (Ord. Nos. 19942; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Height And Stories
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-295.110. MAXIMUM HEIGHT AND STORIES.

Maximum height for any structure on the Property is 110 feet, and maximum number of stories is seven. (Ord. Nos. 19942; 25711)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-295.111. PARKING.

Parking for each use must be provided in accordance with Chapter 51A. (Ord. Nos. 19942; 25711)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-295.112. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Division 51A- 7.300. (Ord. Nos. 19942; 25711)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-295.113. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Use of the Property must comply with the requirements of all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19942; 25711)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-295.114. ZONING MAP.

PD 295 is located on Zoning Map No. H-6. (Ord. Nos. 19942; 25711)
